title: Precision Pilot Model
text: 表示 Precision Pilot Model，输入 2 路、输出 1 路；按 {Type of control} 指定飞机动力学控制；{Pilot gain} 指定飞行员增益、{Pilot time delay(s)} 指定飞行员时间延迟、{Equalizer lead constant} 指定均衡器超前常数、{Equalizer lag constant} 指定均衡器滞后常数、{Lag constant for neuromuscular system} 指定滞后常数、{Undamped natural frequency neuromuscular system (rad/s)} 指定无阻尼自然频率、{Damping neuromuscular system} 指定神经肌肉系统阻尼、{Controlled element undamped natural frequency (rad/s)} 指定受控对象无阻尼自然频率，按实例取值。

ports.name: x
ports.summary: 由飞行员控制的信号 scalar

params.name: Type of control
params.values: 飞机动力学控制 Proportional (default) | Rate or velocity | Acceleration | Second order

params.name: Damping neuromuscular system
params.values: 神经肌肉系统阻尼 0.7 (default) | scalar

params.name: Controlled element undamped natural frequency (rad/s)
params.values: 受控对象无阻尼自然频率 15 (default) | scalar
